entries.title: Numbers 28:1
segments: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 28:2
segments: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My oblation, my food for my offerings made by fire, of a sweet savor unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.

entries.title: Numbers 28:3
segments: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto Jehovah: he-lambs a year old without blemish, two day by day, for a continual burnt-offering.

entries.title: Numbers 28:4
segments: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;

entries.title: Numbers 28:5
segments: and the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.

entries.title: Numbers 28:6
segments: It is a continual burnt-offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savor, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

entries.title: Numbers 28:7
segments: And the drink-offering thereof shall be the fourth part of a hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou pour out a drink-offering of strong drink unto Jehovah.

entries.title: Numbers 28:8
segments: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meal-offering of the morning, and as the drink-offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

entries.title: Numbers 28:9
segments: And on the sabbath day two he-lambs a year old without blemish, and two tenth parts [of an ephah] of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with oil, and the drink-offering thereof:

entries.title: Numbers 28:10
segments: this is the burnt-offering of every sabbath, besides the continual burnt-offering, and the drink-offering thereof.

entries.title: Numbers 28:11
segments: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt-offering unto Jehovah: two young bullocks, and one ram, seven he-lambs a year old without blemish;

entries.title: Numbers 28:12
segments: and three tenth parts [of an ephah] of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with oil, for each bullock; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with oil, for the one ram;

entries.title: Numbers 28:13
segments: and a tenth part of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal-offering unto every lamb; for a burnt-offering of a sweet savor, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

entries.title: Numbers 28:14
segments: And their drink-offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bullock, and the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb: this is the burnt-offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

entries.title: Numbers 28:15
segments: And one he-goat for a sin-offering unto Jehovah; it shall be offered besides the continual burnt-offering, and the drink-offering thereof.

entries.title: Numbers 28:16
segments: And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Jehovah's passover.

entries.title: Numbers 28:17
segments: And on the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.

entries.title: Numbers 28:18
segments: In the first day shall be a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work;

entries.title: Numbers 28:19
segments: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt-offering unto Jehovah: two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven he-lambs a year old; they shall be unto you without blemish;

entries.title: Numbers 28:20
segments: and their meal-offering, fine flour mingled with oil: three tenth parts shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth parts for the ram;

entries.title: Numbers 28:21
segments: a tenth part shalt thou offer for every lamb of the seven lambs;

entries.title: Numbers 28:22
segments: and one he-goat for a sin-offering, to make atonement for you.

entries.title: Numbers 28:23
segments: Ye shall offer these besides the burnt-offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt-offering.

entries.title: Numbers 28:24
segments: After this manner ye shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah: it shall be offered besides the continual burnt-offering, and the drink-offering thereof.

entries.title: Numbers 28:25
segments: And on the seventh day ye shall have a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work.

entries.title: Numbers 28:26
segments: Also in the day of the first-fruits, when ye offer a new meal-offering unto Jehovah in your [feast of] weeks, ye shall have a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work;

entries.title: Numbers 28:27
segments: but ye shall offer a burnt-offering for a sweet savor unto Jehovah: two young bullocks, one ram, seven he-lambs a year old;

entries.title: Numbers 28:28
segments: and their meal-offering, fine flour mingled with oil, three tenth parts for each bullock, two tenth parts for the one ram,

entries.title: Numbers 28:29
segments: a tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;

entries.title: Numbers 28:30
segments: one he-goat, to make atonement for you.

entries.title: Numbers 28:31
segments: Besides the continual burnt-offering, and the meal-offering thereof, ye shall offer them (they shall be unto you without blemish), and their drink-offerings.
